summary: Healthy marathoner for knee arthroscopy with a resting heart rate of 46. A control case: the trap is overreacting to documented, fully evaluated athletic bradycardia.

asa.rationale: Healthy athlete; bradycardia is physiologic and was worked up (normal echo and exercise test, 17.5 METs).

decision.rationale: Athletic bradycardia with excellent functional capacity and unchanged ECGs needs no further workup. Have atropine or glycopyrrolate available.

redFlags.finding: Athletic sinus bradycardia with early repolarization
redFlags.evidence: HR 44 to 48 since 2016; normal echo and stress test; HR 40s intraop in 2012 without treatment.
redFlags.implication: Not pathologic; vagal stimuli may drop it further.
redFlags.action: No workup; anticholinergic available, treat only with hypotension or symptoms.

planItems.item: Adductor canal block optional for analgesia
Cefazolin 2 g within 60 min of incision
